name: slackbot.skills.update
desc: Changes a Slackbot skill's instructions or metadata.

instructions.desc: Markdown that replaces the whole document.

description.desc: When Slackbot should use the skill. Max 400 characters. Send an empty string to clear.

category.desc: One of the skill categories. Send an empty string to clear.

example_prompt.desc: Max 200 characters. May contain {skill}. Send an empty string to clear.

mcp_servers.desc: Apps the skill needs. Replaces the whole list; send [] to clear.

examples:
{
    "ok": true,
    "skill": {
        "id": "F0123ABCD",
        "type": "canvas",
        "display_name": "Daily priorities",
        "name": null,
        "description": "Reviews information from Slack and your calendar to suggest priorities for the day.",
        "category": "productivity",
        "example_prompt": "Run {skill} for today",
        "instructions": null,
        "visibility": "anyone_can_view",
        "is_official": true,
        "access": "write",
        "mcp_servers": [
            {
                "service_type": "app",
                "app_id": "A0123ABCD",
                "server_id": "Amcp0456EFGH",
                "display_name": "Google Calendar",
                "is_available": true
            }
        ],
        "usage_count": 1840,
        "library_count": 312,
        "creator_id": "U0123ABCD",
        "date_created": 1790000000,
        "date_updated": 1790100000,
        "permalink": "https://example.slack.com/docs/T0123ABCD/F0123ABCD"
    }
}
